subject: LumenHealth CAIQ: control alignment lane and evidence ticketing
messages:
From: Tara Simpson <tara.simpson@lumenhealth.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: audit-team@lumenhealth.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake and preferred evidence delivery approach

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for taking this on. Attached is LumenHealth's CAIQ intake PDF with a handful of clarifying notes in the right-hand column. We're on a tight audit window (kickoff 6/21) and we need a concise mapping back to CSA controls and one primary evidence artifact per control where possible.

Two asks up-front: 1) can you give us a single consolidated tracker for owners + evidence filenames, and 2) a short summary of any controls we plan to contest/scope out so our audit team can review prior to kickoff?

Happy to jump on a 30-minute call this week if useful — Tara

--
Tara Simpson
Senior Audit Manager, LumenHealth
T: (415) 555-0199
From: irene choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Simpson <tara.simpson@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake and preferred evidence delivery approach

Hi Tara — appreciate the PDF, we reviewed it and sketched a plan.

Plan highlights:
- We'll produce a single CAIQ Response Tracker (spreadsheet) that lists CSA control IDs, our short response, primary evidence filename, and an assigned internal owner.
- For any control where evidence is a live log (telemetry / runtime), we'll include a static export (redacted) plus a playbook entry describing how to reproduce the query for auditors.
- We'll surface any scope contest proposals early (expected ~5-8 controls) with rationale and suggested compensating controls.

Deliverables and timeline:
- v0.1 Tracker (attached) by EOD Tuesday 6/15.
- v0.2 with owner confirmations and attachments uploaded to shared Drive by 6/17.
- Final review package (zip + index) by 6/19 for your audit kickoff on 6/21.

Marissa will run the evidence intake and owner assignment; Jonas will validate technical runtime samples.

Would you prefer a DocuSign or Google Drive delivery for the final zip?

Thanks,
Irene

--
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Irene / team — attaching v0.1 of the CAIQ Response Tracker (caiq_response_tracker_v0.1.xlsx). Quick notes:
- I've pre-populated ~40% of controls with proposed artifacts (policy docs, KMS attestations, network diagrams).
- Two controls flagged for technical sampling: CC-06 (runtime isolation telemetry) and CC-22 (KV cache retention). Jonas, can you confirm which exported logs we should include and short reproduction steps?
- Proposed owners column uses the following shorthand: ENG-PLATFORM = Platform Eng, CS-OPS = Customer Success Ops. We'll convert to individual owners once we map names.

Tara — we'll upload artifacts to the Drive folder and provide a short index for each file. Please confirm whether auditors prefer hashed filenames or readable names (we can do either).

Also FYI: I'm opening a JIRA ticket (JIRA-SEC-4821) to track outstanding evidence tasks and their SLAs — will link from the tracker.

Attachments: caiq_response_tracker_v0.1.xlsx

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference

Folks — confirmed export plan for the two technical samples:

1) CC-06 runtime isolation telemetry
- Artifact: runtime-isolation-sample-20260616.json (redacted) — attached to Drive.
- Reproduction: query via internal telemetry service (script provided in DRY_DOCS/runtime_queries.md), timeframe 2026-06-10 to 2026-06-14, sample size 2k requests.

2) CC-22 KV cache retention
- Artifact: kv-retention-snapshot-20260615.csv (redacted).
- Note: retention windows vary by deployment; we included an attestation statement and a short matrix mapping retention by environment.

I've updated JIRA-SEC-4821 with subtasks and owner assignments (ENG-PLATFORM -> Rohan Mehta; CS-OPS -> Marissa).

Next steps: Marissa to upload v0.2 with attached artifacts; Irene to review contested controls list and share rationale doc by Thursday 6/17. I'll be on standby for any log extractions.

Cheers,
Jonas
